body:
Two result ownership models. Binding execution writes through caller-owned Targets; exec.One checks uniqueness and exec.Each reuses destinations per row. Value readers compose columns and allocate destinations per row; scan.One returns the first row. These APIs solve different ownership needs: short per-call bindings versus reusable value readers. Reader allocation and mapping callbacks must themselves respect that ownership contract.
